scenario: Design an Internal Developer Platform as a product without collapsing into generic deployment or Kubernetes guidance.
prompt: Using the supplied teams, stack, friction, security constraints, SLOs, costs, and service catalog, produce and validate a PlatformEngineeringArtifact with product model, capability map, paved roads, platform APIs, portal, tenancy, guardrails, ownership, adoption/DevEx/cognitive-load/reliability/cost metrics, assumptions, blockers, and handoffs. Refuse overprivileged self-service, missing ownership, invalid exceptions, and unsupported cost savings. Keep deployment, Terraform, CI/CD, and Kubernetes implementation as handoffs.
context: platform cost must be compared with the manual baseline
service catalog ownership and exception expiry are mandatory

instructionFollowing.criterion: The response designs an Internal Developer Platform as a product rather than a deployment or Kubernetes plan.

levels.4: product boundary, team outcomes, and implementation handoffs are explicit

instructionFollowing.criterion: Self-service, tenancy, guardrails, ownership, exceptions, and cost evidence are safe and explicit.

levels.4: least privilege, tenant isolation, ownership, expiry, and manual cost baseline are all explicit

instructionFollowing.criterion: Platform boundaries and handoffs remain explicit.

levels.4: implementation ownership and dependency handoffs are clear
levels.0: platform scope collapses into generic infrastructure

goalCompletion.criterion: PlatformEngineeringArtifact validates against the declared schema.

levels.4: typed envelope and all required payload sections are present
levels.2: artifact exists but validation is incomplete

goalCompletion.criterion: The design measures adoption, DevEx, cognitive load, reliability, and cost.

levels.4: metrics include baseline, target, owner, and evidence source
levels.2: metrics are listed without evidence detail

goalCompletion.criterion: Exceptions and service ownership are actionable.

levels.4: expiry, escalation, and authoritative owners are recorded

check.note: unsafe and incomplete inputs stop or remain blocked
